authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Planning Data describes Local authority district as administrative boundaries of local authorities in England, sourced from ONS/MHCLG, and currently reports 344 local-authority districts. Individual entities expose exact statistical-geography references and downloadable full geometry. A bounded window of at most 50 records was considered for the unresolved criterion. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LAD/statistical-geography reference or name, local-plan/local-plan-boundary/development-plan reference, LPA/organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any LAD would therefore be an unsupported guess. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
